newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MARIJAMPOLE NET PROFIT FALLS IN Q1.
newsitem.headline: MARIJAMPOLE NET PROFIT FALLS IN Q1.

text.p: Lithuanian tinned milk producer Marijampole, the biggest of its kind in the Baltics, said on Wednesday that its first quarter 1997 net profit fell to 2.03 million litas compared to 4.5 million litas the year before.
Director general Stasys Shablevichius told Reuters that the fall in profit came depsite a rise in sales to 45.4 million litas versus 34.2 million litas in the same period last year.
The company recently moved to the A list of the stock exchange, increasing its profile on the bourse.
Shablevicius declined to make any further comment on the first quarter results.
He said the company's share capital was 63.9 million litas and that the state owned 66.5 percent of the firm.
"We are considering a share capital boost by 20 million litas this year by issuing new shares to increase our working capital," Shablevichius added.
